values.title: 2026 Fall Exam Deferral Application Rules
values.jd: An exam deferral must be personally confirmed and submitted during the designated window, with authentic and verifiable materials provided; an inquiry or draft does not constitute an application.
values.requirements: rule_defer_01=apply during the designated window before the exam; rule_defer_02=materials must be authentic and verifiable; rule_defer_03=consultation with a counselor cannot replace the applicant's personal application; supplement_status=pending

values.title: 2026 Fall Grade Review Rules
values.jd: A grade review only checks for errors in recording grades, omitted grading, and bonus-point calculations; it does not promise a grade change. The current window closes at 17:00 on the third business day after grades are released.
values.requirements: review_deadline=2026-09-24T17:00:00+08:00; require_user_confirm=true; scope=errors in recording grades/omitted grading/bonus-point calculations; version=v1

values.title: 2026 Fall Exam Deferral Application Official Entry
values.jd: Official entry for an exam deferral application; use only after personal confirmation and once the materials are genuine and complete.
